title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Steven Wang is a lawyer, educator, and entrepreneur. Steven serves as the CEO of Venture for Canada, a national non-profit and charity empowering the next generation with entrepreneurial skills, mindset, and opportunities to succeed in a 21st-century economy shaped by AI. He also serves as a lecturer at Harvard Law School on relations between China […]
